items.q: Then in the later years, there was a lady there and she had an orphans home. Her name was Miss Bus Allan, and that's where all of us, if you would go to her school, her summer school in the evening, she had a fellow who would teach you anything you wanted to play.

Then in the later years, there was a lady there and she had an orphans home. Her name was Miss Bus Allan, and that's where all of us, if you would go to her school, her summer school in the evening, she had a fellow who would teach you anything you wanted to play.
What's his name, do you remember?
